sentences.en: England is synonymous with football, fish & chips, and the Queen.
sentences.zh: 英格兰与足球、炸鱼薯条和女王有着不解之缘。

sentences.en: I shouldn't have eaten the whole bag of potato chips.
sentences.zh: 我本不该把整包薯片都吃光。

sentences.en: I ate the whole bag of potato chips by myself.
sentences.zh: 我独自把整包薯片都吃光了。
